details.claim: Stonehenge was constructed in several phases, beginning about 3100 BC and continuing until about 1600 BC.
The famous circle of large sarsen stones was placed between 2600 BC and 2400 BC.
Radiocarbon dating suggests the bluestones were placed between 2400 and 2200 BC.
Burials from as early as 3000 BC have been found within the site.
